summary: Aggregate a GeoZarr dataset to DHIS2 org units and export DHIS2 JSON

parameters.name: dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published GeoZarr collection to aggregate (as listed under /datasets).

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Time range to load as [start, end] ISO-8601 date strings.

parameters.name: geometries
parameters.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of organisation units. Each feature's `id` is used as the DHIS2 orgUnit identifier.

parameters.name: data_element_id
parameters.description: DHIS2 data element id assigned to every exported value.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Spatial aggregation method applied to the pixels within each org unit: mean (default), min, max, or sum.

parameters.name: period_type
parameters.description: DHIS2 period type used to format each time step (day, week, month, quarter, year). Should match the dataset's native temporal resolution.
